context: Two defects, two origins. (1) published-floor's equality (tags[-1] == v<manifest>) comes from 26c71a117 (ci(T-047-87), 2026-09-21) as a pytest assert that skipped on a shallow clone; 1c7ff0a16 (test(T-050-161), 2026-10-03) moved it into repo.py:516; it judged nothing until eb49cf765 (test(T-050-156)) gave the Guards job fetch-depth: 0 (ci.yml:116), so the 0.4.7 release PR #264 passed on a shallow clone and 0.5.0's is the first release PR it judges. (2) The version-label and version-shipped clauses (fix 0b699b120) and their plants at repo.py:1230-1232 (8636d8f09, f0da680c6, 2026-10-20) anchor on the literal 0.4.7, and on a shipped tree version-label cannot trip by a pyproject edit. release-please's release PR moves the manifest, pyproject and CHANGELOG to the new version before the merge mints its tag (release.yml), so on that PR the manifest is one release ahead of the last tag by design (repo.py:1231's own comment models that state). Main accepts PRs from develop and the release PR only, and Guards is required there, so the release cannot merge. The release-PR gate failures recur (memory-gate-reds-the-release-pr-on-the-version-bump, cli-digest-stamps-the-version-so-every-release-pr-drifts-docs-cli, pr-source-guard-refuses-the-release-please-pr-to-main, gitflow-law-refuses-the-release-pr-the-releases-law-promotes): no gate is run against a tree shaped like the release PR before that PR exists.
expected: On the release PR's tree (manifest, pyproject and CHANGELOG top at the new version, the last tag one release behind) scripts/guards/run.py and run.py --planted both pass, as they do on the work branch and on main; published-floor still refuses a manifest behind the last published tag, and no plant anchors on a version literal.
repro: d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q https://github.com/marcoaureliomenezes/dadaia-workspace.git $d/r && cd $d/r && git fetch -q origin release-please--branches--main && git checkout -q 15843dcce && python3 scripts/guards/run.py | grep -A1 'FAIL release-workflow-canon'  # published-floor; and run.py --planted: plant anchor lost '0.4.7'
symptom: PR #269 (chore(main): release 0.5.0, head 15843dcce, manifest and pyproject 0.5.0, last tag v0.4.7), CI run 41347026279, job 'Guards (scripts/guards)': 'FAIL release-workflow-canon' / 'release-workflow-canon: published-floor: release.yml / release-please / version clause broken' (guards) and 'AssertionError: plant anchor lost in .release-please-manifest.json: '0.4.7'' at scripts/guards/repo.py:870 (guards --planted). scripts/guards/repo.py:516 '"published-floor": not tags or tags[-1] == f"v{manifest["."]}"'; :1230 '"version-label": _re("pyproject.toml", ..., 'version = "0.4.7"')'; :1232 '"version-shipped": _edit(".release-please-manifest.json", "0.4.7", "0.5.0")'.
